text:
You explore Pighead’s farm. You
find 1 large knife, 1 rope, 3 Food
points, and 1 shotgun (but no
shotgun shells). Pighead has also
a collection of human victims (Save
vs. L2 Fear 2 or lose 1 Sanity).
You find a little girl chained to a
wall. Her eyes are blank and you
shudder at the thought of the
horrors she must have
experienced.
Why didn’t the maniac feed her to
his demonic pigs? And why did
Pighead draw a rough pentacle
with blood on the floor around
her?  You try to talk to the girl but
she won’t respond. You may free
her by going to unique event #8
or leave her to her fate. This
however will cause you to
automatically lose 1 Sanity.

zh-CN.title: 6 - 猪头人的农场
text: 你调查猪头人的农场，找到1把大刀、1根绳子、3点食物和1把霰弹枪（但没有霰弹）。猪头人还收藏着一批人类受害者；进行一次L2恐惧防御检定，失败则失去1点理智。你发现一个小女孩被锁链拴在墙上。她双眼空洞，你不禁为她经历过的恐怖而战栗。你想不通那个疯子为什么没有把她喂给恶魔猪，也不明白猪头人为甚么用血在她周围画了一个粗糙的五芒星。你试着和女孩交谈，但她毫无回应。你可以前往独特事件#8救她，或者任她留在此处。不过，若你选择离开她，便会自动失去1点理智。
